# `Browser.Connectivity`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Connectivity — read the browser online/offline state over
`Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

Distinct from `Ipe.Browser.NetworkInfo`, which surfaces network-information
HINTS (effective type, downlink, RTT) from `navigator.connection`.
`Connectivity` surfaces the binary online/offline event stream from the
`online`/`offline` window events and `navigator.onLine`, without reading any
connection-quality hint.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests the state (`connected` one-shot or a
continuous `watch`), and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the reply — a decoded
`Bool` or a typed unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec and
fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:connectivity` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.Connectivity` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant
it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Connectivity.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `connected` returns a `Task Error Bool`
    via the correlated port→Task bridge; `watch` is `Cmd`-shaped, and `changes`
    is the inbound subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed
    `Result Error Bool`. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability
    becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped variant.

## `connected`

```ipe
connected : Task Error Bool
```

`connected` — read the current online state ONCE, as a `Task Error Bool`.

`True` when `navigator.onLine` is `true` (the browser believes the device is
online); `False` when offline. Uses the correlated port→Task bridge
(`Js.request`). A typed unavailability resolves the `Task` with `Err`; no
companion subscription is needed.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:connectivity`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort Connectivity ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a CONTINUOUS online/offline stream; each `online`/`offline`
window event delivers a fresh state on the `changes` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `changes`

```ipe
changes : (Result Error Bool -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`changes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error Bool` — an `Online` state becomes `Ok True`/`Ok False`, an
unavailability a typed `Err`.
